names.note: The name given in some Latin recensions before his baptism.
The nominative of «Мч. Христофора» in this folder's Russian citation.
From «Άγιος Χριστόφορος ο Μεγαλομάρτυρας» in this folder's Greek citation, without the rank.
Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 9 mai, «Sfântul Mucenic Hristofor».

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's heading for the Julian 9 May, „Свети мученик Христифор.“ — Свети left off, which is not a rank, and мученик left off, which is the `martyr` this folder already carries in `types`. The heading gives no epithet, no city and no year; Spain, the plagues and the 249 are all in the body. **The spelling is the book's own and was not corrected**: Христифор with an и, where this folder's Russian form and `christopher-20-april`'s Serbian form are both Христофор with an о. A direct walk of every `names` entry in `saints/` finds no folder holding Христифор, so the form folds with nothing and the one-letter difference is what keeps it out of the fold the two Христофор forms already make.

death.note: The passions place his martyrdom under Decius. There is no independent evidence for the date, or for the person.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 9 мая ст. ст.; «Мч. Христофора»

attestations.note: The day's third entry, four sentences long, and the same menologion day the Russian, the Romanian and the Greek already keep him on, so nothing moved. **The 249 was read and refused.** „Намучен за Христа и прослављен од Христа 249. године.“ lies inside the 249–251 this folder already holds for his death, and taking it would narrow a three-year interval to a single year on one book's word — the refusal the coordinator has standing over `silvanus-of-gaza`'s 311 inside «(IV)» and `pelagia-of-tarsus`'s 287 inside 287–290. `dates` are untouched. **`wonderworker` is added to `types`**: „Велики чудотворац.“ is the entry's opening sentence, Чудотворац is the rank word BRIEF-SERBIAN.md §5 reads as `wonderworker`, and it does not conflict with the `martyr` this folder already carries — it stands beside it as it does on `nicholas-of-myra`. Велики is left off everywhere, being the epithet "the Great" which §5 says is no rank, and this folder's display name is the bare forename. **New here and in no other book read for this folder**: that he is especially honoured in Spain, and that the people pray to him most of all against infectious diseases and great mortality. **The Serbian spells him Христифор with an и**, where the Russian line on this same folder and the Serbian line on `christopher-20-april` both give Христофор, so the new form folds with nothing. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.

hymns.text: Cu haine din sângiuiri împodobindu-te, stai înaintea Domnului împăratul puterilor, Hristofore pururea-mărite, unde cu cetele celor fără de trupuri şi ale mucenicilor cânţi dulce cântare întreit-sfântă şi înfricoşătoare; pentru aceasta prin rugăciunile tale mântuieşte turma ta.

english.text: Adorned with garments made of thine own blood, thou standest before the Lord, the King of the powers, ever-glorified Christopher, where with the choirs of the bodiless ones and of the martyrs thou singest the sweet and fearful thrice-holy hymn; therefore by thy prayers save thy flock.

hymns.text: Одеждами от кровей украшался,/ Господеви предстоиши, Царю сил, Христофоре приснопамятне,/ отонудуже со Безплотными и мученики поеши/ трисвятым и страшным сладкопением./ Темже молитвами твоими спасай стадо твое.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 9 мая ст. ст., «Тропарь мученика Христофора», глас 4 — proper to him, and it names him; it is the same hymn as the Romanian troparion this folder already carries, in Church Slavonic

english.text: Adorned with garments made of thine own blood, thou standest before the Lord, the King of hosts, O ever-memorable Christopher; and from thence thou singest with the bodiless powers and the martyrs the thrice-holy and awesome sweet hymn. Therefore by thy prayers save thy flock.

hymns.text: Свыше, премудре, звание приял еси,/ Христу тезоименит быв, Христофоре славне,/ мучеником Божественная доброто./ С ними же всегда моли/ согрешений разрешение даровати нам.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 9 мая ст. ст., «Кондак мученика Христофора», глас 2 — proper to him, and it turns on the meaning of his name

english.text: From on high, O most wise one, thou didst receive thy calling, becoming namesake of Christ, O glorious Christopher, divine beauty of the martyrs. With them pray without ceasing that the forgiveness of our sins may be granted us.
